source_selection: One coherent bounded source-defined early club, local organization and WWII factory-team identity tranche, 16 distinct named team families, 22 literals, 39 games. Groups were resolved by original SDSU evidence, independently matching opponent-series aggregates and corroborating club/aircraft/Caterpillar official institutional documentation; source-name-only entities retain scope limitations and are not assigned speculative ancestry.

families.resolution_evidence: Established San Diego YMCA founded in 1882. Three original labels refer to the source-named San Diego YMCA organization-sponsored regular team; SDSU historical seven-game series exactly confirms 2+4+1. This is a source-name team identity, not proof of unchanged roster or specific YMCA building. Separately named YMCA All-Stars remain independent.

SDSU opponent record independently lists one 1923-24 San Diego YMCA All-Stars match, and deliberately names a distinct All-Stars unit rather than the regular San Diego YMCA squad. Both trace to local Y, but no automatic team merge.

families.display: First National Bank (San Diego source team)
families.resolution_evidence: Seven 1921-25 source-series contests appear under one San Diego State First National Bank opponent in independent basketball results, matching 6+1 original literal variants. Name scoped to historical SDSU opponent/team, not an assertion identifying a specific bank charter, successor institution, or other nationwide First National Bank.

SDSU historical series confirms two contests against San Diego AC with original labels 'at San Diego Athletic Club' and 'San Diego Athletic Club'. Separate source-named 'B' squad is not merged; neither source 'at' nor club identity is a basketball venue inference.

SDSU historical opponent-series explicitly names a San Diego AC(B) 1928-29 contest, distinct from first San Diego Athletic Club team. Keep B team as separate basketball identity despite shared club sponsorship.

Four SDSU WWII-era games in 1943-44 and 1944-45 against the same literal Veteran's Service League team across 'at' and plain labels; independent basketball series counts four (3-1) and matches raw 2+2. Do not assert exact veteran organization charter or home facility.

The accepted SDSU source has four 1933-37 Alhambra Athletic Club opponents; independent San Diego State historical series lists four Alhambra AC games. This is a source-named athletic club team, without unsupported facility/geographic or ownership inference.

Two SDSU 1941-42 games against source-named Consolidated Aircraft team independently corroborated; San Diego Air & Space Museum documents actual Consolidated plant and its 1943 merger with Vultee. This key represents the pre-merger company team, not post-merger Convair Dominators or Vultee's separate Downey workplace.

SDSU 1944-45 game precisely labels Convair Dominators; independent historical series validates one contest. San Diego Air & Space Museum documents the consolidated company known as Convair after March 1943; namesake squad does NOT prove that earlier Consolidated Aircraft roster or Vultee Downey team is identical.

Caterpillar's own 2014 historical publication identifies famous Caterpillar Diesels / Peoria Cats industrial basketball program, and Peoria sports history documents its 1950s elite competitive team. 'at Peoria Diesels' and 'Peoria Caterpillar Diesels' are equivalent 1949-50 and 1950-51 historical basketball-team names, not any separate Peoria college team.

Historical SDSU series identifies exactly two games against Ryan All-Stars, matching accepted 1944-45 source count. Name-only identity retained; while San Diego had Ryan Aircraft, attribution of these basketball players to Ryan Aeronautical employees is unverified and is not asserted.

Independent historical SDSU results preserve the literal source spelling 'Lockhead Air' for precisely two 1940-41 opponents. Preserve a source-defined wartime company squad, without asserting the specific Lockheed corporate plant or silently spelling the source as Lockheed.

SDSU historical series lists 1943-44 Rohr opponent; San Diego Air & Space Museum historical corporate archive confirms Rohr Aircraft operating in Chula Vista by 1941 and the WWII era. This factory-affiliated source-name team distinct from Ryan, Consolidated or Convair.

Source 1921-22 names a San Diego Rowing Club basketball opponent; independent SDSU series lists exactly one game. The established source-named rowing club basketball team does not prove specific corporate/rowing club founding identity, sporting venue or unchanged roster.

1942-43 original source explicitly names 20th Century Fox opponent. Preserve as distinct source-named film-studio basketball team without asserting a particular local branch, employee roster or employer contract.

Original 1944-45 source explicitly qualifies Vultee Aircraft team with 'Downey'; San Diego Air & Space Museum records corporate merger with Consolidated in March 1943. Preserve Downey-qualified source squad independently from earlier Consolidated San Diego squad and named Convair Dominators; no continuity of basketball rosters inferred.

San Diego Athletic Club first squad distinct from B squad
